title: Uncorrectable (double-bit) ECC error followed by GPU falling off the bus; training job crashes

expected.reason: An uncorrectable memory error (XID 48) then XID 79 means the GPU is gone from the PCIe bus. Needs a node drain and RMA (return to vendor). The job failed.

glossary.XID: NVIDIA driver error code. 48 = double-bit ECC, 79 = GPU fell off the bus.
glossary.ECC SBE/DBE: Single-bit errors are auto-corrected; double-bit errors corrupt data.

labels.message: GPU has fallen off the bus
